column3: “Chains” renders the bronze fetter without specifying the material.
“His arrows” renders the sons of His quiver.
Being their song becomes being mocked in song.
“Intoxicated” specifies the effect of giving wormwood to drink.
“Dust” replaces ashes; trampling specifies the act of pressing down.
The casting away from peace is rendered passively.
“God has disciplined him” identifies the subject and specifies the unstated burden laid on him.
“Bury his face” replaces put his mouth; “still” is added.
